svg.text: Day 8 adds a private Tailscale ingress (no Funnel), Prompt Guard on the request path, and GHCR images pinned to a commit SHA.
access: SSH tunnel over Tailscale / k8s API
k3s v1.36 · server node gpu-node (control plane)
secrets encryption on · Traefik disabled · API bound to 127.0.0.1:6443
node obs-node · CPU only · every Day 7 chart sets the nodeSelector + toleration
model on PVC · not in image
kubectl top + free -m on the monitoring node
stage A 0.9 GiB · stage B 1.9 GiB · stage C 0.2 GiB = about 3 GiB (estimate was 3.4–5.3 GiB)
node: 15,298 MiB total · 4,845 used · 10,452 available · 0 swap used
Langfuse at about 1/5 of its documented minimums: fine for one user, not for production
Tempo: TraceQL {resource.service.name="mcp-server"} found the trace (root service rag-worker, 2.68 s cold model reload)
Loki: {k8s_namespace_name="si-lab"} != "healthz" != "GIN" cut 1,000 lines to 20 real ones
Prometheus: {job="si-lab/mcp-server"} 74 series · p50 about 9 ms, p95 about 4.3 s (one cold reload, small sample)
Langfuse: POST → POST /mcp → search_notes (TOOL) → Ollama embed + pgvector SELECT, 0.04 s
Open WebUI, Grafana and Langfuse are tailnet HTTPS. kubectl still uses the SSH tunnel, now over Tailscale, for the API.
node gpu-node pulls these three images.
The gated model stays on the PVC,
SSH (admin, keys only): terminal → monitoring node
